about.title: Atherton Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Atherton is a small town — about 7,167 residents in San Mateo County — and losses here are felt closely. In 2025, the town's public record shows 3 injury collisions, 3 people hurt, and no traffic deaths. Still, wrongful death claims are not limited to car crashes on Middlefield Road, El Camino Real, Route 82, or Alameda de las Pulgas. A fall on someone else's property, a defective product, or negligent care can also take a life, and California law lets certain family members seek accountability through a civil action. That action stands apart from any criminal case. It can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a government entity is involved. LawProactive does not practice law. We are a free service that listens to what happened and connects Atherton families with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death claims on a contingency basis.

whyChoose.title: Why Atherton Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines Watched Closely
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a public entity is involved. Getting connected early protects that timeline.

items.title: A Civil Claim, Not a Criminal One
items.desc: Whether or not prosecutors act, your family's civil action moves on its own track and can recover funeral costs, lost support, and the loss of companionship and guidance. Network attorneys take these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Atherton recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death claims here are rare?
items.answer: Low collision counts on roads like Middlefield Road and El Camino Real are welcome, but wrongful death claims arise from many causes beyond driving. Falls on unsafe property, negligent medical or elder care, and defective products can all support a claim. If a loved one died because of someone else's negligence anywhere in or around Atherton, it is worth a conversation.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law puts a surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the decedent's children first. If there are none, certain dependents and heirs may have standing instead. Because these rules can be confusing in blended or extended families, an attorney should confirm who may file before the deadline approaches.

items.question: What can my family actually recover, and how long do we have?
items.answer: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. The general deadline is two years from the date of death, but it is shorter if a government entity such as a city, county, or state agency may be responsible. LawProactive can connect you at no cost with an independent attorney who will explain how these rules apply to your situation.
